name: Silverwash
effect: If someone has compelled you to drink this draught in any way, you immediately cough/wretch it out, unable to drink it. If you drink it freely, then you are under the effects of silverwash for 1 hour. While in this state, you are slightly more suggestable than usual (no more than alcohol makes you)

name: Potion of Sound Mind
effect: When you use this item you suddenly feel less guilty about your past deeds. You are unsure whether the effect will wear off.

name: Potion of Fish Oil
effect: When you use this item flip a coin. On heads, you recover from being Injured. On tails, you slip and fall.

name: Potion of False Charisma
effect: When you use this item you become pitiable. For the next five minutes, you may show this card to people you're talking with. They feel immense pity for you.

name: Potion of Nettleflower
effect: When you use this item, you become instilled with a great sense of joy, pride, and confidence for a few minutes. You also become fairly itchy.

name: Potion of Borrowed Dreams
effect: When you use this item, you recall that you were formerly a cooper of some renown. For the next few minutes, you have extremely strong opinions on the construction of casks and barrels.

name: Potion of Borrowed Dreams
effect: When you use this item, you recall that you were formerly a chef of some renown. For the next few minutes, you have extremely strong opinions on what foods should and should not be paired with a fine red wine.

name: Potion of Mermaid Blood
effect: When you drink this potion, you recover from being Injured.

name: Potion of Witchhunter's Pepper
effect: When you drink this potion, if you have ever done an immoral deed, you must immediately sneeze.

name: Potion of Emotional Release
effect: When you drink this potion, you are able to process one difficult emotion. Side effects include tears of joy and/or sadness.

name: Potion of Emotional Repression
effect: When you drink this potion, you become unaffected by a difficult emotion.

name: Potion of Morality
effect: When you drink this potion, you feel the urge to do something dastardly.

name: Potion of Morality
effect: When you drink this potion, you feel the urge to do something nice.
